name: Lindenderry at Red Hill
address: 142 Arthurs Seat Rd, Red Hill VIC 3937
signature: A Red Hill hotel set on 34 acres of gardens and vines, with an on-site dining room and a weekend cellar door.
editorNote:
Lindenderry's Red Hill setting makes a weekend easy to keep in one place: rooms and suites, estate gardens, a vineyard, an on-site dining room and a cellar door. The hotel lists dinner in The Dining Room from Thursday to Saturday and cellar-door visits on weekends. Breakfast is served at the hotel; check your room package and reserve dinner before building the rest of the weekend around it.

Leave time to walk the gardens between bookings, or use the hotel as a base for the Red Hill cellar doors. Confirm current dining and tasting hours directly when you book.

The operator also lists an Alba Thermal Springs & Spa package pairing a Red Hill hotel stay with bathing at Alba in Fingal. Choose that package explicitly if you want bathing included, check current terms and arrange travel. A room-only booking does not by itself establish Alba entry.
whyWeGo: Stay among Red Hill's gardens and vines with dining and a weekend cellar door on the estate.
ifOnlyOneThing: Reserve your room and dinner directly, then leave time to walk the estate gardens before or after breakfast.
